title: Eval Card
description: The Eval Card of A·G.2, extended with the six fields 15.6 requires of a release gate: metric, dataset and its version, n_cases, passes_per_case, threshold and min_detectable_effect. A threshold with no sample size and no passes per case is not a gate, it is a superstition. The six fields are per metric, as the capstone gate of 18.4 tabulates them. Criterion for use: knowledge/protocols/release-gate.md.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this gate.

scope.description: Which layer is being measured. Origen: A·G.2 and 15.2 (component, trajectory, end to end).

baseline.description: The date of the series this run is compared against.
baseline.$comment: Loader contract: an eval card is written in YAML (A·G.2) and `baseline: 2026-07-01` is parsed by yaml.safe_load as a date object, not a string. Whatever validates a card must serialize YAML timestamps to ISO-8601 strings first, or the book's own card fails on a type error that has nothing to do with the gate.

dataset.description: The card's dataset. A threshold against a moving set measures the set, not the agent, so the version is required.

pii.description: How personal data was handled in the set. A·G.2 spells this `anonymized`.

metrics.description: One entry per gate. Each entry carries the six fields of 15.6.

threshold.description: The number that blocks the release.

n_cases.description: Sampling noise. Size the set for the drop you care about before fixing the threshold: the relation is quadratic (15.6).

passes_per_case.description: Execution noise. A single pass is an observation, not a measurement; report an interval (15.6). One pass is legitimate only where retrieval is deterministic over a frozen index (18.4, Recall@5).

min_detectable_effect.description: The difference considered real. Below it the verdict is neither pass nor fail: it is inconclusive, and the response is more sample, not more argument. A number in metric points, or `cualquiera` where any occurrence counts (18.4, adversarial leaks).

dataset.description: Override, only when this metric runs against a different set than the card's.

judge.description: Judge noise. When an LLM scores the result it is a second non-deterministic system measuring the first: record its id, its version and its agreement with hand labels. Changing the judge invalidates the historical series (15.6).

release_gate.description: Whether this card stops a release. A card nobody executes is documentation.
